info.name: Work Order Safety & Checklist Mobile API
info.description: Comprehensive REST API collection for Mobile App Developers (React Native / Flutter / iOS / Android / Field Service) to fetch safety templates, view work order checklists, submit safety inspections with GPS & digital signature, upload photo evidence, and update inspection statuses.

request.description: Authenticates against Salesforce OAuth endpoint using Username-Password or Client Credentials flow and saves the access token in collection variables.

Fetches standard checklist categories and predefined questions (PPE, Electrical Lockout, Site Clearance, Fire Safety) to store in mobile local storage (SQLite/WatermelonDB/AsyncStorage) for offline forms.

response.name: 200 Success - Checklist Templates

request.description: Fetches required PPE checklist, site hazard clearance protocols, risk level assessment, and safety warnings tailored to the equipment type.
Submits technician pre-job safety sign-off, PPE verification, and hazard checks. Inserts safety audit activity into Salesforce.
